hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/queue/config.json" ]; then cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/templates/session-note.md"; elif [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/claude-queue/config.json" ]; then cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/templates/session-note-legacy.md"; fi; exit 0

[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/queue/config.json" ] || exit 0; input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"agent_id"'*) printf '%s' "$input" | node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/queue.mjs" hook pre-tool-use ;; esac; exit 0
